name: make
description: Turn recurring work you spot in Cursor into Make automations and AI Agents that keep running in the cloud. Build, run, and manage them from Cursor, connected to the apps and data they need. Everything stays visible in Make's visual landscape, so you can inspect and change it anytime.

skills.name: make-scenario-building
skills.description: Use when creating a new Make scenario or editing an existing one — finding modules, connections and account-dependent values, wiring the flow, saving through scenario_create or scenario_patch. Not for explaining, running or debugging a scenario, or for API-call shells.

skills.name: make-scenario-explore
skills.description: Use when orienting in a Make account — listing organizations, teams and scenarios, explaining what an existing scenario does, checking connection health, auditing several scenarios. Not for creating, editing, running or debugging.

skills.name: make-scenario-operations
skills.description: Use when running a scenario, switching it on or off, reviewing or debugging executions, or investigating a webhook that receives nothing. Not for creating, editing or explaining a scenario.

skills.name: make-scenario-reference
skills.description: Load when a Make scenario tool answers 403, refuses a write for a reason you cannot explain, or no tool seems to cover the request — the shared conventions of environment_get, scenario_*, app_find, module_spec, module_field_resolve, connection_*, data_store_* and data_structure_*
